description: AWS VPC Endpoint (Interface) hourly charge (4+ subnets - default to 4)
match_query: type = aws_vpc_endpoint and service_class = endpoint_interface and values.subnet_ids.3

description: AWS VPC Endpoint (Interface) data processed (usage-based, 0 by default)
match_query: type = aws_vpc_endpoint and service_class = data_processed_interface

description: AWS VPC Endpoint (GatewayLoadBalancer) hourly charge (730 hours per month)
match_query: type = aws_vpc_endpoint and service_class = endpoint_gwlbe

description: AWS VPC Endpoint (GatewayLoadBalancer) data processed (usage-based, 0 by default)
match_query: type = aws_vpc_endpoint and service_class = data_processed_gwlbe

description: AWS VPN Connection hourly charge (730 hours per month)
match_query: type = aws_vpn_connection and service_class = vpn_connection

description: AWS VPN Connection Transit Gateway attachment hourly charge (only when transit_gateway_id is set)
match_query: type = aws_vpn_connection and service_class = transit_gateway_attachment and values.transit_gateway_id

description: AWS VPN Connection Transit Gateway data processed (usage-based, 0 by default)
match_query: type = aws_vpn_connection and service_class = transit_gateway_data and values.transit_gateway_id

description: AWS EC2 Transit Gateway Peering Attachment (730 hours per month)
match_query: type = aws_ec2_transit_gateway_peering_attachment and service_class = transit_gateway_attachment

description: AWS EC2 Transit Gateway VPC Attachment (730 hours per month)
match_query: type = aws_ec2_transit_gateway_vpc_attachment and service_class = transit_gateway_attachment

description: AWS EC2 Transit Gateway VPC Attachment data processed (usage-based, 0 by default)
match_query: type = aws_ec2_transit_gateway_vpc_attachment and service_class = transit_gateway_data
